mapper.insert: INSERT INTO itinerary_plans (user_id, source_plan_id, title, city, duration, pace, total_days, spot_count, summary, preferences_json, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sourcePlanId}, #{title}, #{city}, #{duration}, #{pace}, #{totalDays}, #{spotCount}, #{summary}, CAST(#{preferencesJson} AS JSON), 1)

INSERT INTO itinerary_plan_items (plan_id, day_no, order_no, item_type, time_slot, target_id, spot_id, place_group_id, name, description, address, image_url, rating, hotness, longitude, latitude, recommend_reason) VALUES (#{planId}, #{dayNo}, #{orderNo}, #{itemType}, #{timeSlot}, #{targetId}, #{spotId}, #{placeGroupId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{address}, #{imageUrl}, #{rating}, #{hotness}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{recommendReason})
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, city, duration, pace, total_days AS totalDays, spot_count AS spotCount, copy_count AS copyCount, favorite_count AS favoriteCount, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM itinerary_plan_favorites f WHERE f.plan_id = itinerary_plans.id AND f.user_id = #{userId} ) AS favorited, summary, preferences_json AS preferencesJson, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM itinerary_plans WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM itinerary_plans WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1

SELECT ip.id, ip.title, ip.city, ip.duration, ip.pace, ip.total_days AS totalDays, ip.spot_count AS spotCount, ip.copy_count AS copyCount, ip.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, 1 AS favorited, ip.source_plan_id AS sourcePlanId, sp.title AS sourcePlanTitle, up.nickname AS ownerName, ip.summary, ip.preferences_json AS preferencesJson, ip.created_at AS createdAt, ip.updated_at AS updatedAt, f.created_at AS favoritedAt FROM itinerary_plan_favorites f JOIN itinerary_plans ip ON ip.id = f.plan_id AND ip.status = 1 LEFT JOIN itinerary_plans sp ON sp.id = ip.source_plan_id LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON up.user_id = ip.user_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND ( ip.user_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM travel_logs l JOIN circles c ON c.id = l.circle_id AND c.status = 1 JOIN circle_members cm ON cm.circle_id = c.id AND cm.user_id = #{userId} WHERE l.itinerary_plan_id = ip.id AND l.status = 1 ) ) ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, ip.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM itinerary_plan_favorites f JOIN itinerary_plans ip ON ip.id = f.plan_id AND ip.status = 1 WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND ( ip.user_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM travel_logs l JOIN circles c ON c.id = l.circle_id AND c.status = 1 JOIN circle_members cm ON cm.circle_id = c.id AND cm.user_id = #{userId} WHERE l.itinerary_plan_id = ip.id AND l.status = 1 ) )

SELECT id, title, city, duration, pace, total_days AS totalDays, spot_count AS spotCount, copy_count AS copyCount, favorite_count AS favoriteCount, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM itinerary_plan_favorites f WHERE f.plan_id = itinerary_plans.id AND f.user_id = #{userId} ) AS favorited, source_plan_id AS sourcePlanId, summary, preferences_json AS preferencesJson, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM itinerary_plans WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1

SELECT ip.id, ip.title, ip.city, ip.duration, ip.pace, ip.total_days AS totalDays, ip.spot_count AS spotCount, ip.copy_count AS copyCount, ip.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM itinerary_plan_favorites f WHERE f.plan_id = ip.id AND f.user_id = #{userId} ) AS favorited, ip.source_plan_id AS sourcePlanId, sp.title AS sourcePlanTitle, up.nickname AS ownerName, ip.summary, ip.preferences_json AS preferencesJson, ip.created_at AS createdAt, ip.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM itinerary_plans ip LEFT JOIN itinerary_plans sp ON sp.id = ip.source_plan_id LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON up.user_id = ip.user_id WHERE ip.id = #{id} AND ip.status = 1 AND ( ip.user_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM travel_logs l JOIN circles c ON c.id = l.circle_id AND c.status = 1 JOIN circle_members cm ON cm.circle_id = c.id AND cm.user_id = #{userId} WHERE l.itinerary_plan_id = ip.id AND l.status = 1 ) )

SELECT ip.id, ip.title, ip.city, ip.duration, ip.pace, ip.total_days AS totalDays, ip.spot_count AS spotCount, ip.copy_count AS copyCount, ip.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM itinerary_plan_favorites f WHERE f.plan_id = ip.id AND f.user_id = #{userId} ) AS favorited, ip.source_plan_id AS sourcePlanId, sp.title AS sourcePlanTitle, up.nickname AS ownerName, ip.summary, ip.preferences_json AS preferencesJson, ip.created_at AS createdAt, ip.updated_at AS updatedAt, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS shareCount, MAX(l.created_at) AS latestSharedAt FROM itinerary_plans ip JOIN travel_logs l ON l.itinerary_plan_id = ip.id AND l.status = 1 JOIN circles c ON c.id = l.circle_id AND c.status = 1 JOIN circle_members cm ON cm.circle_id = c.id AND cm.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN itinerary_plans sp ON sp.id = ip.source_plan_id LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON up.user_id = ip.user_id WHERE ip.status = 1 GROUP BY ip.id, ip.title, ip.city, ip.duration, ip.pace, ip.total_days, ip.spot_count, ip.copy_count, ip.favorite_count, ip.source_plan_id, sp.title, up.nickname, ip.summary, ip.preferences_json, ip.created_at, ip.updated_at ORDER BY (ip.copy_count * 3 + ip.favorite_count * 2 + COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) DESC, latestSharedAt DESC, ip.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, plan_id AS planId, day_no AS dayNo, order_no AS orderNo, item_type AS itemType, time_slot AS timeSlot, target_id AS targetId, spot_id AS spotId, place_group_id AS placeGroupId, name, description, address, image_url AS image, rating, hotness, longitude, latitude, recommend_reason AS recommendReason FROM itinerary_plan_items WHERE plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY day_no ASC, order_no ASC, id ASC
SELECT user_id AS userId, title FROM itinerary_plans WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE itinerary_plans SET copy_count = copy_count + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO itinerary_plan_favorites (user_id, plan_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{planId})
mapper.update: UPDATE itinerary_plans SET favorite_count = favorite_count + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
UPDATE itinerary_plans SET favorite_count = GREATEST(favorite_count - 1, 0), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
